title: Secura Electric Coffee Grinder and Spice Grinder with 2 Stainless Steel Blades Removable Bowls
features: Pulse Control & Double-Lid Visibility - Master your grind with intuitive, press-and-hold lid operation. The transparent double-lid design allows you to monitor the texture in real-time while effectively preventing splashing and dust, ensuring a clean kitchen and the exact coarseness you desire

Bowl-Activated Safety Lock - Engineered for total peace of mind, the integrated safety lock ensures the blades only operate when the grinding bowl is securely fastened in place. Combined with built-in overheat protection, this system prevents accidental starts and protects the motor from damage, ensuring long-lasting reliability

Stainless Steel Blade Grinder - Equipped with premium, corrosion-resistant stainless steel blades and a high-performance 200W motor, this grinder maintains a steady RPM for uniform results. It transforms beans and spices into a consistent texture in seconds, preserving natural oils and full-bodied flavor

Removable Bowl & Effortless Cleanup - The detachable grinding bowl makes emptying and pouring your grounds or ingredients simple and mess-free. The bowl is completely dishwasher-safe for a quick cleanup, while the integrated cord storage keeps your countertop organized and clutter-free

Note - Always put the inner lid on the bowl before grinding. Avoid exceeding the Max line volume at one time or grinding very hard foods such as cinnamon, cloves or coconut, as these foods may damage the motor, inner lid or cause other problems. There will be a certain sound when grinding
